title: Gaspard's homework lessons and practice advice
summary: Gaspard gave lessons to prepare at home, played back at the next lesson, with freedom on practice time.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: He was fairly strict, was he?

Yeah, strict. Yeah. When you get to him, but when you're out in town, he was a musician. You understand? He was never tired to show you up. If you'd seen him, you'd think he'd know anything. Yeah, yeah. He'd just look like a fellow that's carrying a trombone. Yeah, he wouldn't think he was a great musician to look like. Yeah, but if he gets you in his house, then taking lessons, then he'd get strict. Yeah.
Did he give you a lesson to do at home from the method book?
He gave me a lesson to do at home too, you know. And he told me not to take nothing by his head. That's what he gave me, you know.
Then when you went back to him, you had to play that lesson?
I had to play that lesson. I had to play it for him.
To see what I had to study. I had to play it for him. How much did he run you to practice? Did he tell you how much to practice a day or anything? Well, he told me to practice as much as I wanted to.
